name: Prestige Marigold Phase 2
location: North Bengaluru, off Bellary Road, near Doddaballapur
tagline: Many moments. One place. Life, in full bloom.
overview: Prestige Marigold Phase 2 is a plotted residential community in North Bengaluru's fast-growing corridor off Bellary Road, 15 minutes from Kempegowda International Airport. Buyers acquire a serviced plot and build their own villa on their own timeline, within an established Prestige township that also includes Prestige Marigold Phase 1 and the neighbouring Inventure Academy.
highlights: Plotted development — own the land and build your dream home your way
Plots from 1,200 sq.ft to 4,000 sq.ft, with custom sizes available
Just off Bellary Road, 15 minutes from Kempegowda International Airport
Set within the established Prestige Marigold Phase 1 ecosystem
Inventure Academy (North) located right next door
Imposing entrance with 15m wide entrance road; internal roads 9-15m wide
Clubhouse with pool, lap pool, kids pool and 90,000+ sq.ft of landscaped amenities
Plug-and-play plotted offering — Prestige handles approvals, setback norms, water and sanitation infrastructure
amenities: Plot for a premium educational institute within the township

items: 15m wide imposing entrance road, classical-style architecture
Internal roads 9, 12 & 15m wide with asphalted driveways
Landscaped avenue on either side of the road
Defined concrete access from approach road to each plot
LED streetlights partially solar powered
Underground conduits for fiber optic data/voice provision
Underground power lines from transformer yards to individual feeder pillars
Underground dual water supply via UPVC pipes for domestic and treated use
Plumbing lines terminated within plots for water supply & sewage
Underground sanitary lines connected to central STP
Centralized OHT & underground sump
Sewage treatment plant
Water treatment plant with underground sump tank
Organic waste convertor
DG power for common services
Security cabin at main entrance
24/7 security with RFID boom barriers at main gate
CCTV at main entrance/exit, service yards and children's play area
STP treated water used for common landscape irrigation and flushing
Recharge pits for rainwater harvesting
Urban garden areas
Avenue plantation with low-maintenance plants
Landscape lighting for hardscape and softscape

locationInfo.summary: Strategically located in North Bengaluru's fastest-growing corridor just off Bellary Road, 15 minutes from Kempegowda International Airport, and set within the established Prestige Marigold ecosystem alongside the upcoming Inventure Academy (North).
